entries.label_vi: Đánh giá liên tục → theo dõi tiến bộ, phản hồi kịp thời, thưởng cho học đều thay vì nhồi nhét
entries.claim: Continuous assessment tracks progress over time and rewards steady work instead of last-minute cramming.
entries.because: Coursework, projects and regular quizzes show what a student can do in different situations, and teachers can give feedback while there is still time to improve.
entries.result: Assessment becomes part of learning rather than its conclusion.
entries.rebuttal: Coursework needs moderation rules because of plagiarism, teacher workload and inconsistent marking; a short final test can verify the work.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thay thi bằng đánh giá liên tục, dạy theo dự án, giảm áp lực thi.

entries.label_vi: Bài thi chuẩn hoá → thước đo khách quan, so sánh công bằng, tạo động lực ôn tập
entries.claim: Standardised testing provides a clear and objective measure of achievement.
entries.because: Every candidate faces the same questions and marking criteria, so teachers, parents and employers can compare performance across schools; the prospect of a test motivates systematic revision.
entries.result: Standards stay consistent and weak schools can be identified and supported.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe ủng hộ thi cử / bài kiểm tra chuẩn hoá.

entries.label_vi: Một bài thi = ảnh chụp một ngày; nội dung/ngôn ngữ thiên vị một số nhóm
entries.claim: A single test offers only a snapshot of performance on one day and does not give equal conditions to all candidates.
entries.because: Illness or nerves lower the score of capable students; unfamiliar contexts and language disadvantage some communities; families with money buy preparation.
entries.result: A procedure that looks neutral can reinforce existing inequalities.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề 'bài thi có công bằng không', thi đại học, kiểm tra chuẩn hoá.

entries.label_vi: Học theo dự án → vận dụng kiến thức, làm việc nhóm, nhớ lâu, động lực
entries.claim: Project-based learning develops understanding and practical skills.
entries.because: Pupils investigate a real question, apply knowledge, plan their time and cooperate, and they retain ideas longer than facts memorised for a test.
entries.result: Reluctant learners who find exams stressful stay motivated.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề dạy theo dự án, thực hành, STEM, giảm áp lực thi cử.

entries.label_vi: Bài tập nhiều hơn ≠ học nhiều hơn: lợi ích giảm dần, bài lặp vô nghĩa
entries.claim: More homework does not necessarily mean more learning.
entries.because: Beyond a modest amount, repetitive worksheets and copied answers consume time without deepening understanding, especially for younger pupils.
entries.result: Diminishing returns and pupils who see learning as a chore.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề bài tập về nhà, hiệu quả học tập, tuần học ngắn.

entries.label_vi: Tuần học ngắn → nghỉ ngơi, sở thích, gia đình; giáo viên bớt kiệt sức
entries.claim: A shorter school week gives students time to recover physically and mentally.
entries.because: An extra free day allows sleep, hobbies, exercise and family time, and teachers gain preparation time and are less likely to suffer burnout.
entries.result: Lower stress, better mood and better teaching.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề tuần học 4 ngày, wellbeing, giờ học muộn hơn.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: phụ huynh đi làm khó trông con, học sinh khó khăn mất giờ học
entries.claim: The benefits depend on careful planning.
entries.because: Working parents may struggle to arrange childcare and disadvantaged pupils may lose structured learning time.
entries.result: Schools should offer optional supervised activities.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề thay đổi lịch học.

entries.label_vi: Đồng phục → che khác biệt giàu nghèo, giảm trêu chọc, tiết kiệm cho gia đình
entries.claim: A common uniform masks differences in income that would otherwise be obvious.
entries.because: Pupils from low-income homes avoid embarrassment about secondhand clothes, and parents no longer face constant demands for fashionable brands.
entries.result: Children are judged on behaviour and effort rather than labels, and bullying over clothes falls.
entries.rebuttal: Uniforms are limited: they can be costly and do not remove deeper inequalities in resources and home support, so they should be affordable and subsidised.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề đồng phục, bình đẳng, bắt nạt, chi phí học tập.

entries.label_vi: Đồng phục → bớt xao nhãng, cảm giác thuộc về, trách nhiệm
entries.claim: Uniforms remove sources of distraction and foster a sense of belonging and responsibility.
entries.because: Pupils compete less over fashion, staff spend less time on dress codes, and pupils who represent their school behave more carefully in public.
entries.result: Habits of punctuality, neatness and respect carry over into later life.
entries.rebuttal: Uniforms alone cannot create discipline; clear expectations and good relationships matter more.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề kỷ luật, quy định trường học, an toàn.

entries.text: A pupil who struggles with fractions in October, for example, can be helped immediately instead of discovering the problem in a final paper the following summer.
A national examination, for instance, lets a university compare applicants from different regions on equal terms.
A talented pupil who studies in a crowded home and learns English as a second language, for example, may be unable to show her true level.
A group that builds a working model bridge, for example, learns physics far more vividly than a class that only reads about it.
A child who spends two hours copying definitions every evening, for example, rarely gains more understanding than one who completes a single well-designed task.
A teenager who uses a free Friday for sport and volunteering, for instance, returns to school on Monday refreshed.
A school in which pupils arrive in expensive trainers and designer jackets, for example, often has to deal with comparisons, teasing and even theft.
